notes.title: Version 1.08 Patch Notes
notes.content:
v1.08

- [Cloaking Feather] item added to treasure chests throughout the game and to various Memory Orb vendors. This item causes random enemies on the map to ignore you for one minute.

- [Magical Harp] item added to New Game+.* This item can be used an unlimited amount of time and causes random enemies on the map to ignore you for one minute.
*If you are already in New Game+, simply return to the World Map to receive this item.

- A 'break' of 4 seconds has been added after each battle (both victory and escape), in which random enemies on the map will neither chase you nor notice you.

- Spelling error corrected in the Sewers.

- Passability of rubble in the Mighty Wizard's Castle fixed

notes.title: Version 1.01 Update
notes.content:
[img]http://www.majhost.com/gallery/starmies4/WhisperOfARose/faces.png[/img]

We've just launched an update for Whisper of a Rose, which includes:
[list][*]New face graphics for non-playable characters.
[*]Enemy balancing for Love Dungeon and Montas College.
[*]Additional item chests in Butterfly Hills and Montas College.[/list]

Have fun! ^_^
